deep.reconstruction:
This page contains no mathematics. It is the opening of a German letter draft by Riemann in brown ink. It is dated 'Göttingen, d. 18. Juli 1860' and addressed 'Hochgeehrter Herr!'. The recipient is not named.

The draft is heavily corrected and has gaps. Its sense is roughly as follows:
(1) 'The interest (Theilnahme) you have shown in my [...] works [inserted words above the line, largely illegible] has pleased me greatly. I am gladly ready to serve you in the study of this theory, as far as is in my power.'
(2) A second sentence apologizes for a late reply. My reading of the image is roughly 'Dass ich Ihr [sehr geehrtes?] Schreiben [so lange?] unbeantwortet gelassen habe, bitte ich gütigst zu entschuldigen' ('Please kindly excuse my having left your letter unanswered [so long]').
(3) A fragment follows: 'Der Grund war ...' ('The reason was ...'), then broken off.
(4) The last fragment reads roughly '... sondern um ..., Ihren Wünschen zu [willfahren, struck] erfüllen.' The struck 'willfahren' is replaced by 'erfüllen' ('to fulfil your wishes').

The rest of the page is blank apart from the archival folio number 133.

The phrase 'dieser Theorie' indicates the correspondent had been studying one of Riemann's published theories. In 1860 the most plausible candidate is the theory of Abelian functions (1857). Some insertion words above line 1 might relate to that, but this is a conjecture and cannot be confirmed from the image.

Context:
- The surrounding sheets are unrelated scratch mathematics. The previous page treats energy conservation, Stokes' theorem and the potential of a double layer (Green's representation, U' = (1/4π)∫A ∂(1/r)/∂n ds). The next page is a constrained-extremum (Lagrange multiplier) condition.
- Riemann evidently reused letter paper for calculations; the draft and the calculations are not connected.

results.what: Draft of a reply letter (dated Göttingen, 18 July 1860) to an unnamed correspondent studying one of Riemann's theories; offers help and apologizes for a delayed answer.

transcription_corrections: Third line likely reads '...unbeantwortet gelassen habe, bitte ich gütigst zu entschuldigen' rather than '...unterbrochen geblieben habe, hätte ich ... zu entschuldigen'.
Third line probably begins 'Dass ich Ihr [sehr geehrtes?] Schreiben ...' rather than 'Obgleich ich ...'.
Fourth line likely 'Der Grund war' rather than 'Die Grund ...'.
In the last line 'willfahren' is struck and replaced by 'erfüllen' (machine transcription has this correctly); the beginning 'sondern um die Erfüllung bald' is uncertain.

The superscript insertion in line 1 transcribed as 'die die Sprache' is doubtful; it is better left as illegible. A reading referring to the subject of Riemann's work (possibly Abelian functions) is conceivable but unconfirmed.
The struck word at the end of line 2 is illegible.
